Product Designer

Remote, India

About the role

Initech is hiring a Product Designer to shape our mobile banking experience used by millions of customers.

  • Build and maintain our design system in Figma

Requirements

  • Strong portfolio of mobile work
  • Experience with prototyping tools

Nice to have

  • Fintech experience
